scope.manifolds: closed connected oriented smooth simply-connected four-manifolds
scope.marking: an arbitrary class alpha in integral H_2
scope.category: a twisted premodular category over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field
scope.equivalence_sense: oriented diffeomorphism and marked integral intersection-form transport

semantic_results: The standard zero-framed positive Hopf presentation has exactly the single global-dimension factor prescribed by Tham Definition 5.11.
Every marking on S2 x S2 is evaluated by the full two-label Hopf sum in its derived THAM-side coordinates.
For an odd intersection form, the normalized premodular invariant is a product of positive and negative shifted Gauss sums in an actual integral diagonalization.

For an even intersection form, the normalized premodular invariant is the product of marked K3, reversed-K3, and explicit hyperbolic block values divided by the zero-marked hyperbolic value for each stabilization.
The public premodular theorem produces the applicable odd diagonalization or even stable K3/H decomposition; it is not a vacuous conditional on caller-supplied decomposition data.
In the modular specialization, the value is D times tauPlus to b2Plus times tauMinus to b2Minus times theta_g to minus alpha squared.

new_explicit_external_input.name: evenIntersectionForm_stableK3H_isometry
new_explicit_external_input.statement: A simply-connected closed oriented smooth four-manifold with even integral intersection form becomes intersection-form isometric, after finitely many S2 x S2 stabilizations, to a finite connected sum of K3, reversed K3, and S2 x S2 blocks.
new_explicit_external_input.reference: David Reutter, Semisimple 4-dimensional topological field theories cannot detect exotic smooth structure, Corollary 3.9 and proof, arXiv PDF pp. 14-15

derived_without_new_axioms: The marking on the even stable model is transported through the supplied isometry and split through the existing connected-sum H2 equivalences.
The marked S2 x S2 coordinates are obtained from the exact handle-homology and turnover equivalences; no coordinatewise primal/THAM identity is assumed.
The modular explicit formula is proved through the CP2 blow-up odd route and does not depend on evenIntersectionForm_stableK3H_isometry.

references.work: David Reutter, Semisimple 4-dimensional topological field theories cannot detect exotic smooth structure
Daniel Ruberman and Saša Strle, Wall's stable realization for diffeomorphisms of definite 4-manifolds

verification.source_red_team_interpretation: These are conservative whole-repository findings, not the final theorem's kernel dependency count. The sole suspicious declaration is the previously reviewed derived definition MarkedStableRealization.

non_claims: No theorem is claimed for non-simply-connected four-manifolds.
The even premodular formula treats arbitrary marked K3 and reversed-K3 values as basic block values; it does not give a further closed expression for them.
The fermionic K3 selection discussion in the prose document is not formalized as a Lean theorem here.
No equality with a legacy numerical evaluator or previous computation artifact is claimed without a separate compatibility proof.
No identification with the original Crane-Yetter state sum is claimed.
